source.generation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE standalone single-frame transparent hit-impact overlay sprite for a realistic cold industrial survival game. Presentation-only visual feedback after a committed hit; it represents no fixed damage value.
Primary request: a compact central physical impact burst consisting of a small puff of charcoal-gray dust, a few very fine tiny metallic sparks, and two or three short white-gold impact streaks close to the center. Realistic restrained metal-hit feeling, crisp tiny glints with softly dissipating dust. This is a subtle local effect, not an explosion. Center concentrated and fading outward cleanly into true transparency.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, completely isolated VFX with no surface, floor, wall, environment, gradient rectangle, checkerboard or black background baked in. Dust and edge wisps use semitransparent alpha.
Style/medium: photorealistic realistic game VFX single frame, cold dark gray dust with sparse muted warm metallic sparks and a tiny pale white-gold flash. Restrained brightness and scale; visible on dark industrial game scenes without a huge glow. No cartoon starburst or anime speed lines.
Composition/framing: square source, ideally 768x768 but accept a square higher-resolution original. Keep the entire effect inside the central 65 percent of the canvas. Small compact burst centered; all sparks and dust wisps fully contained, fading to empty transparent padding well before every edge. No giant radial streaks.
Constraints: no blood, gore, wound, character, human, body part, weapon, target object, equipment, text, digits, symbols, damage numbers, HUD, frame, watermark or scene. No blast fireball, flames, massive smoke, shockwave ring or explosive debris. ONE isolated single-frame overlay only.

composition.object: single compact dust, metallic spark and white-gold short-streak impact overlay

notes: Compact central gray dust puff with short pale gold-white impact streaks and scattered fine metallic glints; no character, weapon, target object or damage digits.

Preview shows slight colored low-opacity fringe around some dust edges; check compositing on actual dark stage during integration.
Raw generated 1254x1254 PNG preserved; suggested 768 export remains a separate delivery step. Single generation only. No browser, code integration or game tests were run.
